data.research_question: Which public organizations relevant to the anarchist-violence organization-enumeration corpus are discoverable from the next unresolved authoritative shard-B U.S. geographic NPAs 661, 667 and 679?
data.method: Bounded area-code organization enumeration using current NANPA geographic-area-code admission before deterministic NPA mod 3 sharding; literal anarchist, anarchist collective, Anarchist Black Cross, Food Not Bombs and mutual-aid queries; locality-derived searches; current first-party organization/federation pages; public Linktree and social endpoints; current public event pages; independent reporting for explicit person roles; repository search for canonical identity reuse; historical directories only as discovery seeds.
classification_rules: Do not infer individual political affiliation from organization proximity, role, event participation or mutual-aid work.
Do not label an organization anarchist absent explicit organization-level evidence.
Historical directories and old social endpoints remain discovery seeds until current status is corroborated.
Do not merge identities from name or handle similarity alone.
Completed NPAs are not repeated without materially new evidence.
Overlay NPAs enumerate the shared geography but existing canonical organizations are reused rather than duplicated.

findings.notes: Bakersfield ABCF remains current-first-party-listed in the ABCF directory; existing canonical org and target reused.

Baltimore Food Not Bombs has September 2026 operational corroboration from Collective Garden; Baltimore Mutual Aid has a current public site and 2026 volunteer information. FNB first-party social status remains unresolved.

Detroit overlay geography produced Eastside Mutual Aid, Detroit Peer Respite and Michigan Mutual Aid Coalition, all with current public organization-controlled surfaces and/or current partner corroboration.
